items.title: Phillip Securities Just Upgraded Palo Alto Networks With a $418 Target. Here’s What Changed
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPhillip Securities upgraded Palo Alto Networks to Buy from Neutral and raised its target to $418 from $346, 18% above the current price. The upgrade follows a fiscal first quarter in which revenue grew 39% and management raised its full-year guidance.

items.title: CrowdStrike’s Zscaler deal sets up Palo Alto rivalry, R.F. Lafferty analyst says
items.summary: Investing.com -- CrowdStrike's (NASDAQ: CRWD) planned $43.9 billion acquisition of Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) is a positive that could give it a product range to rival Palo Alto Networks (NASDAQ: PANW), Paul Rodriguez, senior research analyst at R.F. Lafferty & Co., told Investing.com.

items.title: CrowdStrike to Buy Zscaler in $44 Billion All-Stock Deal. Why They’re Better Off Together.
items.summary: Under the terms of the agreement, Zscaler shareholders will receive 1.135 shares of CrowdStrike common stock for each share of Zscaler common stock they own.

items.title: Cathie Wood and 8 Other Big Funds Bought Airbnb Last Quarter. Ken Fisher and 11 Others Sold. Who’s Right?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the third quarter, nine bought Airbnb, including Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest, and 12 sold, including Ken Fisher’s Fisher Investments. The sellers moved far more money, but two of the three biggest still own large Airbnb stakes, and Fisher sold only 1,600 shares.

items.summary: Key TakeawaysCrowdStrike fell 12% after agreeing to buy Zscaler in an all-stock deal valued at $43. 9 billion.
